svg.title: Arable farmer — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as arable farmer, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A grain stalk with separated kernels stands beside a crescent harvesting sickle and long handle. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
